description: A set of audited financial statements for a nonprofit or company: the independent auditor's report, the basic financial statements and, where present, the Single Audit schedules and findings

entity_name.description: The organization whose financial statements were audited, as printed on the statements

period_end_date.description: The balance sheet date or fiscal year end the statements cover, exactly as printed, e.g. 'December 31, 2024'

auditor_report.description: The independent auditor's report on the financial statements

addressee.description: Who the report is addressed to, e.g. 'The Board of Directors'

audit_firm.description: The name of the audit firm that signed the report

opinion_type.description: The auditor's opinion on the financial statements. 'Present fairly, in all material respects' with no qualification is unmodified

accounting_framework.description: The financial reporting framework named in the opinion, as printed, e.g. 'accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America'

report_date.description: The date of the auditor's report, exactly as printed under the signature

report_city.description: The city and state printed under the auditor's signature

statement_of_financial_position.description: The statement of financial position (balance sheet). Amounts in dollars as printed, without symbols or separators

property_and_equipment_net.description: Property and equipment, net of accumulated depreciation

net_assets_with_donor_restrictions.description: Net assets with donor restrictions, if reported

statement_of_activities.description: The statement of activities (income statement) for the year

revenue_lines.description: Each public support and revenue line, in order, including deductions such as direct benefit costs

amount.description: The amount; negative when printed in parentheses

change_in_net_assets.description: Change in net assets for the year

net_assets_beginning_of_year.description: Net assets at beginning of year

net_assets_end_of_year.description: Net assets at end of year

net_cash_from_operating_activities.description: Net cash provided by (used in) operating activities

net_cash_from_investing_activities.description: Net cash provided by (used in) investing activities; negative when printed in parentheses

net_cash_from_financing_activities.description: Net cash provided by (used in) financing activities, if reported

cash_end_of_year.description: Cash and cash equivalents at end of year

awards_schedule.description: The Schedule of Expenditures of Federal Awards and State Financial Assistance, if present

awards.description: Each award line with an expenditure amount, federal and state, in order

source.description: Whether the line is under federal or state financial assistance

grantor.description: The agency or department heading the line sits under

assistance_listing_number.description: The CFDA / Assistance Listing or CSFA number, as printed

contract_number.description: The contract or grant number, as printed

total_florida_state_expenditures.description: Total state financial assistance for the auditee's home state, as printed, e.g. 'Total Florida State Financial Assistance'

findings_summary.description: The summary of audit results in the Schedule of Findings and Questioned Costs, if present

material_weaknesses_reported.description: Whether any significant deficiency or material weakness in internal control over financial reporting was reported

major_programs_tested.description: The programs or projects tested as major, each as printed

type_a_b_threshold.description: The dollar threshold for distinguishing Type A and Type B programs

low_risk_auditee.description: Whether the auditee qualified as a low-risk auditee

findings_reported.description: Whether any financial statement or major program findings were reported
